question: At a matched 10M-class resident-parameter budget and matched accounted inference-compute budgets, does a shared recurrent latent core provide reproducible verified-generalization headroom over strongest fixed-depth and simple recurrent rivals without protected-domain regressions?

constraints: resident params exactly matched by compiler
accounted FLOPs matched at each comparison budget
no optional V0.17 sidecars in EXP-301

primary_endpoints.verified_success_curve: paired verified task success as a function of accounted inference FLOPs
primary_endpoints.recurrent_compute_gain: normalized area under verified-success versus log2(accounted-FLOPs) over common budgets

protected_floors: no challenge leakage or generator identity overlap
no >2 percentage-point regression on language-sequence control
no increase in invalid-output rate >0.5 percentage points
resident parameter count and accounted compute validated

decision_rule.promote: C_NRS_CORE must clear all protected floors, achieve RCG >= +0.05 versus A_FIXED, show >= +5pp verified success on at least two reasoning families at one common compute budget, and be directionally positive on >=3/4 roots; 95% paired hierarchical-bootstrap CI for aggregate RCG must exclude 0.
decision_rule.kill: Kill H-RD-01 if C_NRS_CORE fails the promote rule without a protocol invalidation. Do not rescue by changing loop schedule, thresholds, roots, task-family weights, or compute accounting after outcome.
decision_rule.diagnostic_only: If gains occur only beyond trained loop depths while representation rank collapses or protected controls regress, mark recurrence unstable and authorize only a distinct recurrence-stability hypothesis, not scale.

analysis_plan.statistical_unit: held-out generator instance, paired across arms; train root is replication stratum
analysis_plan.estimator: root-stratified paired hierarchical bootstrap; family-level effects reported separately before aggregate
analysis_plan.missingness: failed or invalid runs remain in ledger; infrastructure-invalid runs may rerun only under frozen rerun policy
analysis_plan.multiplicity: one primary RCG endpoint; family effects are protected/secondary unless explicitly named in rule
anti_goodhart: early stopping that saves FLOPs while increasing wrong answers
looping that improves seen-depth tasks but collapses at unseen depths
fixed rival intentionally under-computed or under-optimized

posthoc_policy: Any unregistered metric, new task family, altered loop schedule, or new baseline discovered after challenge materialization is exploratory and cannot authorize EXP-302.
